cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. When you call the picnic a success, what are you measuring? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And how do I rank against last year's organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does your clipboard have last year's sandwich total?
